source_and_evidence_policy: Rates and coverage values must come from a product page, technical data sheet, instruction, manufacturer catalogue or verified manual input.
A rate without its condition (layer, coats, substrate, application method or operating cycle) is incomplete.
Product-specific values override no global default because REF-3 defines no global numeric consumption defaults.
Derived values must retain the input fields and formula version used.
Operational consumption of equipment is not material consumption for Module 2 estimates.
